bugs.description: Database.cached_counts builds the where clause by formatting the table names into the SQL text instead of binding them as parameters, so a table name containing a quote changes the query.
Database defines the passphrase for its connection as a string literal in the class body, so the credential is stored in the source and shipped with every install.
_execute_query indexes the first row of the cursor without checking that fetchone() returned a row, so a raw query that returns no rows raises TypeError instead of printing nothing.
